decision.observation: 6 mph, gear 1, timer 40:20.047, dots pale. The conversion kept the car on grass between the white rail fence (below/right) and the gravel road, which now lies up-frame just ahead; a slim pine stands immediately right of the nose, boulders and pines line the road beyond.
decision.hypothesis: The nose points up-frame toward the road only a car length away, so one plain-W second should put the car onto the gravel; steering is unnecessary and risks a stall at this speed.
decision.memory: Conversion at 9 mph dropped to 6 and left the car on grass; the road being straight ahead makes plain W the right move.
